purpose: Source-inventory specification for the five named MathDB collection candidates. The requested MathDB counts are tracking targets only: the frozen MathDB public-list summaries do not expose a collection-membership field, so they are not assertions of exact MathDB membership.

frozen_ulam_membership_method.description: A record is in a Ulam overlap only when its frozen v1.6 provenance.source_collection_id, provenance.source_collection_label, and display problem_number all meet the collection rule below. This is evidence about the frozen Ulam corpus, not proof that a MathDB record belongs to the same external collection.

mathdb_discovery_signal.interpretation: Discovery-only. A matching MathDB title is not treated as an external-collection membership assertion or a statement-identity match.

count_extractor.interpretation: Count of top-level problem records in this pinned upstream YAML snapshot; it is not the requested MathDB target count.

reuse.caveat: The repository license covers the repository work. Preserve required notices and separately review rights in cited original papers, quotations, images, and external links.
Use the versioned repository asset above for reproducible structured metadata. Do not infer a reuse license for site prose merely from public access.

The index links to many independently authored workshop lists in PDF and AIMPL forms. Retain the individual workshop URL and review its terms before copying a full statement or redistributing source text.
AMR is a directory to many source lists. A directory page is provenance for discovery, not a blanket license or a statement-level origin record; retain and evaluate each linked source separately.

mathdb_discovery_signal.interpretation: Discovery-only. The exact edition-and-number title pattern makes these high-quality matching candidates, but an external source locator is still required before assigning a recovery label.

count_extractor.interpretation: The retrieved official announcement states the issue's new-problem count. It is an edition-level count, not a verification that every candidate remains open.

reuse.caveat: The inventory retains only an announcement hash, not the issue PDF or its prose. Acquire and use the statement artifact only after a source-specific rights review.

manual_count_assertion.interpretation: The official page distinguishes the six unsolved problems from the historical seven-problem prize set. This is a collection-level status fact, not a current-proof or statement-completeness verification.

reuse.caveat: Do not redistribute source chapters, diagrams, or prose from the Clay materials on the basis of this metadata inventory. Link to the official source and obtain permission or a specific license before republication.
